summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi CART 2x Daily ETF (CARX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer staples equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Maplebear Inc., doing business as Instacart (NASDAQ: CART), which operates a grocery technology platform connecting national and regional retailers with consumers for online shopping and delivery. CARX was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
